text:
maria: Quick heads-up — kicking off a short run to consolidate temporary admin bindings across prod accounts. Need to coordinate RBAC changes and confirm KMS grant footprints.

raj: +1. What's the scope? whole org or subset?

maria: Start with payments and analytics, then expand. I want to ensure we capture any service keys using KMS grants.

sam: FYI audit logs show many ephemeral grants created by automation at midnight. Query I ran:
```
SELECT principal, role, resource, timestamp FROM audit_logs
WHERE action='grant' AND timestamp > DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 90 DAY)
AND role LIKE '%Admin%'
```
Will share link. :mag_right:

elaine: Can we do canary removals? remove one role from dev-staging first and watch errors for 24h. :eyes: 

maria: Yes. Plan: 1) sample owners and notify 2) canary shift 3) full prune with rollback playbook. Need KMS team to confirm if any grants will break CI keys.

dave: @ops-bot can run an impact scan. `ops-bot run access-scan --targets payments,analytics --output gist`

ops-bot: started scan (job id 3421). ETA ~18m. Reports will include KMS grants and service-account bindings.

raj: Also check stale SAs with no owner in last 120d — they tend to be the dangerous ones.

sam: One gotcha: some infra scripts rely on 'admin' role for listing buckets because of coupled permission checks. We should prepare a minimal role: 'svc-list-only' + kms:Decrypt on key.

elaine: Logging question — will removing perms drop any audit trail? we need to ensure CloudAuditLog retention is >90d else hold.

maria: Good catch. I'll hold any prune until storage + logs confirmed. Also need to add to incident-runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/access-prune

dave: If scan finds high-risk grants, tag as P1 and create a short-lived exception with timestamp + approver. Use label: `access-exception/<ticket>` so we can filter.

maria: OK — I'll post the owner sampling table when ops-bot finishes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sam: Thx. Can we also add a quick smoke test for each canary with the restore command:
`gcloud iam roles update --project=$P --add-iam-policy-binding ...` (placeholder)

maria: Yup. I'll add smoke tests to the playbook and schedule a 10am rollout window tomorrow.
